experiments.why: A selection with extent on both axes, where the new code adds four edge grips after the four corners and renames corner to id.
A zero-height selection, where the new code keeps the corners and adds only the w and e edge grips, giving six grips instead of four.
The zero-width mirror case, where only the s and n edge grips should join the four corners.
An off-origin ellipse with unequal axes, showing whether the local-box offset centres the outline on (5,-3) with x and y radii in the right places and no closing duplicate.
An ellipse with one axis collapsed, which must come back as an empty array rather than a polyline.
A sliver ellipse below MIN_ENTITY_SIZE_MM that passes a plain positive check, where the sampler may give nothing and the new code would return a polyline with no points.
A plain circle now routed through the shared ellipseObject, which must give the same spec and transform as the old circleObject.
A zero-radius circle hitting the rewritten degenerate guard, which must still return null.
An ellipse entity, which the old switch had no case for and the new code turns into an ellipse shape placed at centre less each radius.
A uniform corner scale of an ellipse about an off-centre anchor, a kind the old switch fell through on.

source.quote: expect(handles.map((handle) => handle.corner)).toEqual(['sw', 'se', 'nw', 'ne']);

obligations.statement: For bounds {minX: 10, minY: 20, maxX: 110, maxY: 80}, resizeHandles returns exactly four grips, in the order sw, se, nw, ne.
obligations.why: the change removes or edits this quote in src/ui/design-studio/design-handles.test.ts

source.quote: puts a grip on each corner, anchored to the opposite one

obligations.statement: For bounds {minX: 10, minY: 20, maxX: 110, maxY: 80}, the sw grip sits at (10, 20) and is anchored to the opposite corner (110, 80), and the ne grip is anchored to (10, 20).

source.quote: offers no grips without bounds or extent

obligations.statement: resizeHandles returns an empty list for null bounds and for bounds with no extent, such as {minX: 5, minY: 5, maxX: 5, maxY: 5}.

source.quote: still grips a zero-height selection, which has a width to scale

obligations.statement: resizeHandles({minX: 0, minY: 5, maxX: 40, maxY: 5}) returns 4 grips: a zero-height selection that still has a width is gripped.
obligations.why: the change removes or edits this quote in src/ui/design-studio/design-handles.test.ts

source.quote: starts at (40, 40). Dragging it to (20, 20) doubles the span.

obligations.statement: With a selected circle centred at (50, 50) with radius 10, beginning a resize on its south-west grip at (40, 40) and calling updateSessionResize with (20, 20) leaves the entity a circle with radius 20.

source.quote: does not compound across updates

obligations.statement: Calling updateSessionResize a second time with the same point (20, 20) gives the same circle radius as the first call, because the factor is measured from the gesture's start and never compounded.

source.quote: dragging back to the start restores the original geometry

obligations.statement: Dragging the south-west grip out to (0, 0) and then back to its starting point with updateSessionResize restores the circle's original radius 10 and centre (50, 50).

source.quote: is inert without a selection or without a live gesture

obligations.statement: updateSessionResize returns the very same session object, unchanged, when no resize gesture is live.

source.quote: grows a rectangle about the anchor, corner radius included

obligations.statement: scaleEntity by factor 2 about the anchor (10, 10) scales the test rectangle's width, height and corner radius by 2 (to 80, 40 and 4) while its origin, which is the anchor, stays at (10, 10).

source.quote: keeps a circle a circle

obligations.statement: scaleEntity on a circle centred at (50, 50) with radius 10, anchor (0, 0) and factor 3 returns a circle (not another kind) centred at (150, 150) with radius 30.

source.quote: moves a rectangle by its origin, leaving size and radius alone

obligations.statement: translateEntity by delta (25, -10) moves the test rectangle's origin to (35, 10), keeps it a rectangle, and leaves its width 50 and corner radius 4 unchanged.

source.quote: moves a circle by its centre, leaving the radius alone

obligations.statement: translateEntity by delta (25, -10) moves the test circle's centre to (125, 90), keeps it a circle, and leaves its radius 12 unchanged.

source.quote: drops a circle with a non-finite radius

obligations.statement: sanitizeEntity returns null for a circle whose radius is NaN.

source.quote: drops a zero-length line

obligations.statement: sanitizeEntity returns null for a zero-length line, such as one from (4, 4) to (4, 4).

source.quote: clamps a rectangle corner radius to half the shorter side

obligations.statement: sanitizeEntity clamps a rectangle's corner radius to half its shorter side: a 20 x 10 rectangle with corner radius 40 comes back with corner radius 5.

source.quote: uses equal axes at the diameter

obligations.statement: designEntityToSceneObject turns a circle into a kind 'shape' object whose spec is an ellipse with both axes equal to the circle's diameter.
obligations.why: the quote is not inside a test in src/core/design/to-scene-object.test.ts that calls designEntityToSceneObject

source.quote: never emits construction geometry

obligations.statement: designEntityToSceneObject returns null for any entity marked construction: true, whether rectangle, circle or line.

source.quote: drops a degenerate entity rather than adding an empty object

obligations.statement: designEntityToSceneObject returns null for degenerate entities: a zero-width rectangle, a zero-radius circle, or a zero-length line.

source.quote: Byte-for-byte the canvas geometry: a precise arc must not be re-fitted.

obligations.statement: For an arc, designEntityToSceneObject returns an imported-svg object whose first path's polylines equal entityToPolylines(arc) exactly, with no re-fitting.

source.quote: puts every sampled point on the circle

obligations.statement: entityToPolylines of a circle centred at (5, -3) with radius 10 returns a closed polyline whose every point lies at distance 10 from the centre.

source.quote: does not repeat the first point as the last

obligations.statement: entityToPolylines of a circle returns more than 8 points and does not repeat the first point as the last; closure is carried by the closed flag instead.

source.quote: sweeps counter-clockwise for a positive sweep and clockwise for a negative one

obligations.statement: entityToPolylines samples an arc counter-clockwise for a positive sweep and clockwise for a negative one: for the quarter arc centred at the origin, the second point has y > 0 with sweep 90 and y < 0 with sweep -90.

source.quote: A degenerate entity materializes to nothing rather than to a broken polyline.

obligations.statement: entityToPolylines returns an empty array, not a broken polyline, for a degenerate entity.

source.quote: measures radius centre to rim

obligations.statement: annotationFor(circle, 'radius') returns a radial annotation whose centre-to-edge distance equals the circle's radius.
